annotations.title: Get the finished score as files

description: Before AINSOF works with a video the person signs in once on ainsof.io (Google or email): without a sign_in_code this returns sign_in_required with a link to show them; after they sign in, call again with the same arguments plus that sign_in_code. Hand over the finished score as files, once the user is happy with it. Returns a zip holding the scored video, every section of music as a separate MP3 (192k) trimmed exactly as it was used and named with the timecode it starts at, and a cue sheet. An editor drops each file at the timecode in its name and has the render back on their own timeline. Call this with THE SAME arguments you passed to score_my_video — that is how it finds the right render. It never re-cuts anything. Downloading the zip needs a signed-in AINSOF account with download access (sign in on ainsof.io with Google or email).

brief.description: the same brief you scored with

music_offset_db.description: the same value you scored with, if you set one

sign_in_code.description: the sign_in_code AINSOF returned with its sign-in link, once the person has signed in. Pass it to every video tool in this conversation.

name: deliver_score
